sidecar_purpose: Adjacent metadata sidecar for the canonical compiled asset sheet of Patch's mechanic role kit, recording the consolidated layout, observed visual facts, and downstream usage constraints.
source_truth_note: The PNG file is the source of truth for visual content; this sidecar mirrors its exact dimensions, byte size, SHA-256, and mode. Panel contents and labels must be verified against the image pixels.
runtime_use_note: Approved for use as a canonical reference sheet for Patch in the mechanic role kit. Use to select poses, verify style consistency, and plan compositions for presentation packages and downstream asset generation.
do_not_infer_note: Do not infer additional poses, props, or canon details not visible in the compiled sheet. Do not treat this sidecar as authorizing derivative images or broadening canon beyond the committed PNG.
